name: Law Of God The
overview: The Law of God reveals His holy and just character, commanding exclusive devotion to Him and forbidding idolatry, as seen in the opening commandments of Exodus 20. It underscores the seriousness of honoring God's name and keeping His commandments, promising mercy to those who love Him and obey His statutes. This law not only distinguishes God's people but also reflects His covenantal relationship, delivering them from bondage and guiding them in righteousness.
